# Luck, jobs and learning

## Authors

- Eve Marder<sup>1</sup> †

### Affiliations

1. Department of Biology and the Volen National Center for Complex Systems Brandeis University Waltham United States marder@brandeis.edu

† Corresponding author

## Abstract

Eve Marder believes that many of the most important events in our lives, both personal and professional, depend to some degree on luck or chance.
